Subject: Post-call: POC scope & success criteria

Thanks for the call today — good alignment. Quick recap and next steps so we’re all on the same page:

POC scope (2 weeks):
- Validate Redwood inference for recommendation reranking and chat prompts against Stellar’s dataset (sample: 50k rows).
- Throughput target: sustained 2000 reqs/min during peak test windows.
- Latency target (p95): <200ms for inference-only path.

Success criteria (to be validated end of trial):
- Precision@10 improvement >= 8% vs baseline on benchmark set.
- p95 latency <200ms with 95% of test queries.
- No critical security blockers (access controls + audit logs available).

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Data handoff: Stellar provides sample set and schema (Jamie/Chris) — due 7/24.
- Engineering onboarding & infra: Ethan (Redwood) — will set up test harness.
- Escalation/SRE: Connor (Redwood) — points of contact for infra issues.

Timeline:
- 7/24: data + mutual action plan sign-off.
- 7/27: POC kickoff (10:00 PT) — run baseline tests.
- 8/10: POC wrap + results review.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Stellar.pdf, POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx (initial).

Next steps: please confirm the data delivery timeline and add any other stakeholders (especially security/CTO). I’ll schedule the kickoff for 7/27 10:00 PT once we confirm.

Thanks,

Received the S3 link and started ingesting the sample set. A few technical notes I want to flag early (adding to the POC_Risk_Tracker):

1) Potential memory pressure when using quantized model + batch sizes >16 on our default instance type. Symptom: OOM or degraded performance during long sequences.
   Mitigation: reduce batch_size to 8 for the memory-constrained path; enable prefix/KV caching to reduce repeated computation. We can also test a slightly larger instance class for the spike tests if needed (cost impact to be minimized).

2) Preprocessing mismatch: a small percentage (~2%) of records have unexpected tokens which can cause tokenization edge-cases. Request: sample of ~100 problem records to reproduce locally.

Attaching Logs_stacktrace_429.txt for an unrelated rate-limited run we triggered in a sandbox (was able to reproduce at high concurrency). I’ll schedule a deep-dive with Stellar infra if you want (7/28 suggested).

Ethan
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: POC kickoff - initial blocker (429)

Quick update from the kickoff tests this morning:

We observed sustained 429 (rate-limit) responses when running a 15-minute high-concurrency baseline (simulating spike). I’ve added this as a blocking issue in the POC_Risk_Tracker (ticket ID: RB-POC-1121).

Immediate mitigation applied: lowered client concurrency and enabled client-side retry/backoff which reduced the error rate, but throughput fell below the targeted 2000 reqs/min.

Escalation path: Connor O'Brien (SRE) -> Ethan Park (Engineering) -> Marissa (AE) -> Redwood Infra on-call for quota bump/infra investigation.

Request from Stellar: can you temporarily increase request quota for this POC window (or allow burst capacity) so we can validate throughput without hitting hard limits?
